reason: The price is fair and the WhatsApp changes sound like exactly what I needed last time, but I've heard 'we'll keep it updated' before and then nobody answered. I'm not handing over €600 to a name I don't know just from an ad.
objection: I paid for a website before and it was never updated. Who says these guys will still be around and answering my WhatsApp in two years, in the middle of August?
would_change_my_mind: Seeing a few sites they already built for other konobas or businesses near me and hearing from one of those owners that changes really get done in two days.
